final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ID AS ID, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ID AS ID, s3.c AS c, s3.r AS r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
